style.summary: Cal AI keeps white screens and ink-black #1D1A23 type, with floating white cards on soft grey shadows. Ink black also fills every main button, the progress rings and the add button, so color appears only in food photos and data: macros, streak and progress. A floating 62 pt capsule tab bar and big Semibold numbers like 1250 define the home screen.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: 24 pt side margins; the home screen stacks a week row, a 345 pt calorie card, 3 macro cards and recent meals.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Cards round at about 16 to 20 pt over soft grey shadows; buttons and the tab bar are capsules 48 to 62 pt tall.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: White #FFFFFF screens; ink black #1D1A23 for text, rings and main buttons; grey #7F7F80 for labels and inactive tabs.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: A neutral sans close to Inter: Semibold 600 for 38 pt numbers like 1250, Regular for 11 to 15 pt grey labels.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: Real food photos appear on 4 of 6 shots; 1 shot compares before and after body photos.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: A 62 pt floating capsule tab bar plus a black add button, 90 pt calorie rings, and paired 48 pt pills.

screenshots.alt: Cal AI home screen: 1250 of 2500 calories eaten, protein, carbs and fat rings, and a 550-calorie grilled salmon
Just snap a pic: the camera labels lettuce, parmesan, cherry tomatoes and croutons on a Caesar salad
See the calories: a Caesar salad at 330 calories, 8 g protein, 20 g carbs and 18 g fat, with a black Done button
Track progress: 132.1 lbs toward a 140 lbs goal, a 21-day streak and a 6-month weight chart
Grow with friends: the Shred Squad feed with streak counts and a friend's 480-calorie chicken meal
Watch the change: before and after photos at 355 lbs in Sep 2023 and 182 lbs in Jul 2025, with a Share button

ourRead: One tier, Unlimited, at 5 listed prices from $2.99 to $29.99 across 9 listings. The names hide each plan's length, so the ladder only reads inside the app.
Hard paywall on the core feature: the description says scan results require a subscription. The lifestyle quiz comes first, so the price lands after you build a plan.
Streak Restore, $0.99, sells a lost streak back. The flame count shows on Home, Progress and Groups, so a missed day becomes a sale.
stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Cal AI's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% white #FFFFFF: screens and cards; a #F9F8FE wash behind the header.
- 30% ink black #1D1A23: text, numbers, progress rings and every main button.
- 10% scan grey #7F7F80: labels, units and inactive tabs; ring tracks #EAE9EF.
- Data colors: protein red, carbs orange, fat blue, streak orange.
Type:
- Headlines: Inter 600, about 32 pt titles and 38 pt numbers.
- Body: Inter 400, 11 to 15 pt grey labels; Inter 500 for 16 pt titles and buttons.
Shapes:
- Cards: 20 pt corners, a soft #DEDEE0 shadow 2 pt below. Buttons and tab bar: full capsules.
Layout:
- 24 pt side margins; one column of floating cards.
Components:
- Calorie card: 38 pt number, 15 pt grey goal, 90 pt ring, 6.8 pt black arc.
- Tab bar: 62 pt white capsule, 4 tabs, selected on #EDEDED; a black 62 pt add button.
- Button pair: two 48 pt pills 10 pt apart, one outlined in 1 pt #D6D5DB, one black.
Icons and imagery:
- Grey line icons; real food photos with rounded corners.
Check:
- Every main button is ink black #1D1A23.
- Color appears only in data and photos.
- Cards have 20 pt corners and soft shadows.
